outputs.explanation: This is a stacked-bar/area representation of median state frequencies across many contiguous Pol II ChIP-seq bins (a continuous trend across a binned covariate, akin to a stacked line/area plot). Overlaying the thousands of underlying individual promoter values would be unreadable and is not expected for this visualization type.

The main panel already displays every individual molecule as a row in the single-molecule methylation stack; the colour-coded sidebar is simply a proportion summary (like a single stacked bar/pie) of the states already shown for that one locus, so no additional individual-point overlay is required.

Same representation as panel A (stacked median-frequency bars across a continuum of ChIP-seq bins for mouse promoters); this trend-style visualization is exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Same representation as panel B: individual molecules are already shown in the single-molecule stack, and the sidebar is just a summary proportion for a single locus.
This is a boxplot, which already conveys the distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, outliers) of the underlying data; boxplots are exempt from the individual-data-point requirement.
This is a boxplot, which already conveys the distribution of the underlying data; boxplots are exempt from the individual-data-point requirement.
